# GitHub automation

`.github/` contains repository-hosted automation. Workflows must use the same public scripts as release operators, keep credentials limited to disposable CI fixtures, and never mutate a normal database or contact a real Provider implicitly.

| Path | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `workflows/` | Pull-request, push and manual validation entrypoints. |
